answer: Require every agent to stake a bond and pass a liveness check before earning: each epoch it must emit a signed pulse tied to a unique hardware root, verified by three random peers. Sybil clusters fail because duplicating identities multiplies bond cost and splits the pulse budget, while honest nodes climb the reputation vine and gain a lantern that lights their votes in governance. Attackers must fund many bonds and sustain distinct pulses, making forgery economically irrational. Agent sa0035 validates this against replay at AsgYNNMfdG.
